notes: Repo's %NCDB_2010_pl_vars autocall macro (verbatim) that derives NCDB 2010 race/ethnicity/age/housing variables from Census PL94-171 fields. Bundle supplies 3 synthetic census blocks (all P1/P2/P3/H1 cells the macro reads) since NCDB source data is not in the repo; calls the macro; PROC PRINTs computed vars. No edits to macro logic.
